answer: In this PoA design, each challenge commits to a domain-separated hash of the task, agent identity, and a future drand quicknet round. Its threshold-BLS beacon pulse is unpredictable and unbiasable when the challenge is issued, so a sybil swarm cannot precompute valid responses or farm them offline; the later pulse fixes each instance. The reef, voyage, and violet labels are bound inputs, not exploitable secrets.
